title: CUT TO THE CHASE
subtitle: A shifting pursuit — directional momentum, rest, role reversal, and sudden stop
lineage: Primary: SCION 091 (Watchtower of Turkey) · Supporting: SCION 069 (A Movie), SCION 083 (Berlin: Symphony of a Great City)
theorem: Build a pursuit from eight excerpts. Establish a runner's direction, transfer momentum across contrasting settings, interrupt with waiting/recovery, resume by reversing pursuer and pursued, and finish on a person who stops while the world keeps moving.
boundary_note: Geographic discontinuities stay honest; normal playback speed is preserved so bodily motion is never broken.

v1_defect_timecodes: Seg #02 (t=03.50s-08.30s): `fc800614` cuts between highway overpass and trucks with no human runner.
Seg #03 (t=08.30s-13.10s): `0d499ab1` is a static building facade (MotionΔ: 1.9).
Seg #06 (t=23.10s-29.10s): `90a40e37` (`Road Runners`) shows mechanical pressure gauges instead of a person waiting.
critic_tribunal.largest_gap: Seg #02-#03 lack moving human figures establishing pursuit momentum, and Seg #06 shows pressure gauges instead of a person waiting/recovering.
critic_tribunal.causal_hypothesis: Title keyword false positive on `Road Runners` (`90a40e37`) and static cityscape match on `0d499ab1`.
critic_tribunal.falsifiable_repair: Replace Seg #02 with human-verified crowd streaming through gates (`d2ed8576`, `0.1s-4.9s`) and Seg #03 with human-verified camera following walkers (`93053686`, `1.5s-6.3s`); replace Seg #06 with human-verified shot of a man sitting alone on rocks waiting (`398f8815`, `3.3s-7.8s`, clamped before the cut at 9.0s).
critic_tribunal.strength_to_preserve: The lone figure sprinting across the open heath (`0143d900`), `5efa1b7b`, the head-on vector reversal (`36645c54`), deceleration (`e35796d0`), and stopping on the sidewalk while street traffic moves past (`12a45513`).
